title: Odoo Functional Consultant | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Odoo Functional Consultant. Category: Development. Duration: 10 months. Description: The Odoo Functional Program is a practical, industry-focused training course designed to provide participants with comprehensive knowledge of Odoo ERP and its core business applications. The program covers key modules including CRM, Sales, Accounting, Inventory, and Purchasing. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
